newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Mexico livestock report, feeder export price - USDA.

text.p: USDA reported Tuesday that prices were steady at the main U.S. import entrance for Mexican feeder cattle coming across from Nogales, Sonora.
"Trade moderate, demand moderate. Bulk of supply consisted of steers weighing 300-500 lb," USDA said.
Prices for feeder steers weighing 300-400 lb were 67-72 cents/lb and for those weighing 400-500 lb they were 62-67 cents/lb.
